faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: As an Informatics Engineering graduate from Universitas Muhammadiyah Jember with a focus on Data Analyst and Full-stack Developer, I specialize in data analysis, database management, and efficient web application development.

faqData.q: Are you available for research or freelance collaborations?
faqData.a: Absolutely. I am always open to innovative freelance projects, full-time roles, or technical collaborations that focus on data-driven problem solving and web application development.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack for production?
faqData.a: For data analysis, I use Python, SQL, Pandas, Tableau, and Power BI. For web applications, I typically use React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and Next.js.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with enterprise or lab projects?
faqData.a: Yes, I have worked on various projects such as a daily financial tracking system, technology trend analysis using large-scale datasets, and developing a company profile website for SMEs.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at sulistyowatimunawaroh@gmail.com. I will be happy to respond to discuss your data analysis or system requirements.
